name: Voxel Evaluation with AABB Culling
definition: A technique to compute Signed Distance Function (SDF) values for a chunk's voxel grid on the GPU, using Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) culling to restrict computation to voxels intersecting active SDFs. It solves the problem of unnecessary GPU computation for voxels far from any terrain geometry.
summary: Voxel Evaluation with AABB Culling is a GPU-accelerated technique that computes SDF values only for voxels intersecting active primitives, avoiding unnecessary computation for distant geometry.
